title: The long peace is broken. The Pope proclaims a crusade against al-Andalus, the first, and declares war on the Ṭāʾifa of Aragon; the Emperor answers for his subject. The crusade's temporal support is thin: the Pope's own vassals and a handful of German bishops and princes, some five thousand men at the declaration, most of them levies, though the Pope's own army filled back up to about two thousand regulars by summer

data.target: ARA (the Borja Sultanate of Aragon, as the game styles it)

crusaders.Papal States: 270 men under arms on 3 February (four regiments far under strength: crossbowmen at 10%, men-at-arms at 5%), 26 ships; about 2,000 regulars by July once refilled (Trent)

defenders.the ṭāʾifas: Aragon, Catalonia (400), Valencia (450), the Algarve, Salamanca, Cuenca
defenders.Mamlūks: 4,050 men, with Mecca, Medina, the Dulkadirids, Hutaym, Barqa, Banū Kanz, Suakin, the Western Oases, Val di Noto, Zubāla, Nafūsa and others
defenders.Morocco: 2,400 men, 30 ships, with Tafilalt, Touat and Tlemcen

data.peace: the first war since the Peace of Ramaḍān in 1395, nearly nine years

source: save of 3 February 1404; Trent's account and screen

title: France grants al-Andalus military access, and on 4 July the armies of the faithful march through Languedoc on Avignon, the Pope's city on the Rhône. The Emperor, fifty-six, crosses the border at their head

data.target: Avignon, the papal enclave on the Rhône
data.context: France had shown itself friendly since 1395; the Pope's own lands in Italy lie across the sea

title: The Sephardim of al-Mariyya. Jews from across Iberia have made the town of al-Mariyya a haven, where they live without persecution. Some at court welcome it as equality for all of Allāh's creation; the zealous call it a stain on the empire. The Emperor, in the field before Avignon, rules that the rights of the Jewish people shall be protected, and the crown builds them a community house at al-Mariyya

data.choice: We shall protect the rights of the Jewish people (the option on Trent's screen)

effects.construction: a Jewish Community building in al-Mariyya

data.alternative: Allāh would never allow these unbelievers to live in peace!
data.context: the convivencia proclaimed with the Restoration of al-Andalus in 1375; some 123,000 Jews in the realm in 1395. At the time the Emperor was besieging Avignon, and the crusade's war score stood at +40%
